lines.speaker: chancellor
lines.text: Commander Vale. The nation’s newest hero arrives with concerns.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Combat records. Hollowmere was never a raider base. The relief depot was civilian property.

lines.speaker: chancellor
lines.text: Facts are useful only after someone decides what they mean.

lines.speaker: chancellor
lines.text: You announced your own limits before Hollowmere. ‘Turrets only.’ A commander does not rewrite a national directive in the field.

lines.speaker: chancellor
lines.text: You ordered your lance to follow the target packet exactly. Do not pretend obedience absolves the officer who carried it out.

lines.speaker: chancellor
lines.text: You spared civilians and allowed dangerous witnesses to escape.

lines.speaker: chancellor
lines.text: Your operation injured civilians. That failure sits under your command signature.

lines.speaker: chancellor
lines.text: People died under your authorization. The public will require a responsible name.

lines.speaker: chancellor
lines.text: Hollowmere was a resource. The crisis made it available and made the nation grateful.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: You manufactured the attack, took their relief, and called yourself the rescuer.

lines.speaker: chancellor
lines.text: A frightened country remembers the man carrying water, not who lit the fire.

options.text: Say it publicly: Aldric murdered Hollowmere.
options.spokenText: Aldric murdered Hollowmere. Say it publicly.

options.text: Say nothing and remember every face.
options.speaker: narrator
options.spokenText: Vale says nothing. He remembers every face in the chamber.

lines.speaker: chancellor
lines.text: Arrest Commander Vale for evidence fabrication, treason, and conspiracy.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Every person in this room knows what you did.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Vale remains silent as guards close in, noting who cannot meet their eyes.

lines.speaker: broadcast
lines.text: An unstable decorated officer threatened the Chancellor after conspiring with Hollowmere extremists.

lines.speaker: broadcast
lines.text: Commander Vale declined to deny overwhelming evidence of collaboration with Hollowmere extremists.

lines.speaker: broadcast
lines.text: Chancellor Aldric personally intervened to prevent further violence.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Through the wall, Vale hears editors cutting mission audio into a confession.

lines.speaker: broadcast
lines.text: Vale’s own combat record proves a long pattern of instability.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: They took the mechs and the uniform. They did not take the squad.
